scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,ext -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/extension
scripts.build:browsers: npm run build -w apps/extension && npm run build:firefox -w apps/extension && npm run build:edge -w apps/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run compile -w apps/extension && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
